name: Esch-sur-Sûre in a day
description_md:
Esch-sur-Sûre in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights. The route covers 6.5 km of walking between stops in LU.

The day is anchored in Esch-sur-Sûre and includes four sightseeing stops along the way. About 5.9 hours are required for the full day, and this duration includes the visit time at each stop.
